'''Lipica Shah''' (also credited as '''Lapica Shah''' and '''Lipica Jaclyn''') is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Shah was born in Monmouth Beach, New Jersey, sometime on December 8, and became an actress as an adult. She first worked on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}. Afterwards, she gained more notable roles during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing the [[Officer Jenny]]s of the [[Unova]] [[region]] and the [[Decolore Islands]]. Shah went on to voice [[Sima]], {{an|Kiawe}}'s mother, during {{aniseries|SM}}. In ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', Shah gained another major role portraying {{tc|Top Champion}} [[Geeta]].
